_readme: TEST FIXTURE ONLY — NOT the delivered canon.
Allows every ToolCategory, i.e. upstream dograh behaviour with no platform
governance applied. The pre-existing suite runs under this so that tests for
http_api / mcp / calculator tools keep testing those features; the delivered
canon (deploy/feature-scope.json in the platform repo) allows two categories
and would make those tests assert the absence of the thing they cover.
Tests that exercise the enabled-set filter MUST point PLATFORM_FEATURE_SCOPE
